entry: ResourceSession(start_record, anchors), once before first resource sample; retain same instance for compile/batch
clock_origin_meaning: Stable identity of the monotonic epoch/domain, not an origin supplied anew by each sample
origins: Overall origin is recorded at execution start; native origin is recorded once before native work, independently of resource raw samples. Bind both before the first native resource sample.
identity_binding: anchors.run_id must equal independent start_record.run_id; snapshot scalar anchors and frozen primitive clock fields once
raw_origins: Required corroborating values; exact numeric equality to the fixed context; never used as the elapsed-time origin
immutability: Frozen slotted ExecutionClockContext and ResourceSession; scalar anchor snapshot; no start/context/anchors argument in decide
prior_sample_cursor: Remains the explicit caller-supplied previous_sample_end_s of the prior projection API; origin reset is impossible through this argument. Native sampler/scheduler binding is still OPEN.
source_provenance_limit: Binding establishes internal consistency only. Actual OS clock measurements, authorized run provenance, independent capture and retained lifecycle require a future reviewed provider. No provider implemented or tested here.
